content:
Today's gyaan (don't waste ur sat&sun) 

If people are not respecting your hard work, start learning something new that is in demand.

ur skills can open new doors, create better opportunities, and take u places where your efforts are valued. 

try to never stop learning. Keep upgrading yourself.

#LinkedIn
#connection
comment: Learning new skills matters, but so does knowing when the issue is visibility versus capability. Sometimes the next opportunity comes from communicating your value better, not just adding more skills.
